verdict.rationale: Cake offers an MCP connection for AI agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor) that is documented as 'All read-only', so agent access is inherently limited. There is no evidence that users can issue their own scoped API keys or tokens or choose permissions per agent, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: user-issued API credentials/tokens, configurable scopes or per-resource permissions for agent credentials, credential revocation/rotation docs, independent corroboration.
